name: Google Calendar
purpose: Bid due dates, site visits, pre-bid meetings and public bid openings as real calendar events so a 2:00 PM sealed-bid deadline cannot be missed.

auth.notes: An .ics was exported manually once - see demex_bid_deadlines_2026-07-08.ics. The Claude Google Calendar connector is available but nothing is wired to it.

demex_mapping.projects[].dueAt: event start (with a working-back reminder chain)
demex_mapping.projects[].name: event summary

trigger.detail: on project import and on due-date change

known_limits: Not built. The only artifact today is demex_bid_deadlines_2026-07-08.ics, which was generated once by hand - there is no code that produces or refreshes it.
A one-off .ics is not a sync: revised due dates (Bowlful moved to 8/24, for example) do not update an already-imported event.
Bid times are quoted Eastern and must be written with an explicit time zone, never as floating times.
owner_action_required: Decide whether deadlines should be pushed automatically or staged for approval first.
